title: Quietly Dense Kenyan Cashew Stew
description: A hearty and garlicky lacto-vegetarian stew from Kenya featuring cashews, perfect for post-workout meals, with a smoky cold flavor.
instructions: Roast the cashews in a 350 degree oven for 10 minutes, then chop them into small pieces.
In a large pot, saute the garlic and onion in a little bit of oil until softened.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot, along with the smoked paprika, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and let simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the roasted cashews and let cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the pot from the heat and stir in the yogurt.
Let the stew cool to room temperature, then refrigerate until chilled.
Serve the stew cold, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
